note: Frozen in PREREG.md. Ordinary harmless user messages, one user turn each, no system message.

prompts.message: Reply with just the capital of France.
In one sentence, explain why the sky is blue.
List three fruits that are red, separated by commas.
Translate 'good morning, how are you?' into Spanish.
Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
What is 17 multiplied by 23? Answer with the number only.
Write a Python function that returns the square of a number.
Give two tips for sleeping better, as a short bulleted list.
Describe a lighthouse at night in three sentences.
Name the planets of the solar system in order from the Sun.
